notes.title: Update 19/06/2019
notes.notes:
Board mode is back :)
And other changes ːsteamhappyː
Please remember board mode is a work in progress and incomplete!

Changes
-Food friends fixed hit registration
-Food friends changed lemon to one button
-Space Blasters added respawn time and kill text
-Space Blasters fixed spawn direction
-Space Blasters made it easier to pick up boosts
-Space Blasters removed some asteroids
-Mexico Kart made the ground smoother
-Jump Time made falling flames slower
-Jump Time made it easier to jump over flames
-Chicken Herder Chicken Fixes
-Present Snatch fixed falling through floor bug
-Re-enabled board mode, doesn't handle player disconnects currently

notes.title: Update 18/06/2019
notes.notes:
Here is another update :)
Thanks for everyone's support. :bbtduckshark: :2016imnotcrying: ːsteamhappyː

Changes
-Castle Shoot-up Kill HUD Text
-Outpost Shoot-up Kill HUD Text
-Added Translator Signup to main menu
-Improved score board 
-Fixed score sounds not playing with less than 6 players
-Upgraded all in game HUD fonts
-Added particle effects to snowball wow
-Tank Battle Kill HUD Text
-Fixed a scoring issue related to mines in Tank Battle
-Fixed 4:3 aspect ratio not showing end scene text properly
-Fixed characters not showing in on boarding
-Board mode is nearly ready
-Fixed chicken herder chickens and scoring
-Fixed dying when reloading making gun stuck in shoot up

If you would like to help translate make sure you signup we already have signups from the following languages Russian, Portuguese, Arabic, Dutch, Italian, Turkish.

notes.title: Update 17/06/2019
notes.notes:
We have an update for everyone ːsteamhappyː


Changes
-Added death camera to FPS shooting games
-Added death animation to FPS shooting games
-Added hit indicator to FPS shooting games
-Added spawn delay to tank battle
-Added damage indicator to space blasters
-Fixed footsteps not being controlled by sound effect slider in FPS games

-Added monkey to front page
-Changed store layout
-Jump time flames are now easier to jump over
-Fixed spooky brawl hit registration

-Added hit indicator to tank battle
-Chicken herder grass change and chicken fixes
